local SCOUT_DURATION=5
local SCOUT_MAX_TEAM=3
local SCOUT_MAX_LOS_DISTANCE=90

local function scoreModeAllowed(roster: {Player}): boolean
    return RunService:IsStudio() and #roster>1
end

local function modeVoteSnapshot()
    local roster=eligibleSoloPlayers()
    local selected,classic,five=ModeVote.tally(modeVotes,roster)
    local allowed=scoreModeAllowed(roster)
    return if allowed then selected else ModeVote.CLASSIC,classic,five,allowed
end

local function serverNow(): number
    return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
